comments.author: alice
comments.body: The first commit raised `HTTPException(status_code=409)` here. Services shouldn't know about HTTP: they're also called from the payout worker and the CLI, where an HTTPException makes no sense. Raise the domain error and let the handler in api/errors.py pick the status.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Makes sense, that's the whole point of this PR, embarrassing 🙂. Switched to errors.Conflict.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: ruff's isort rule and ruff-format run in pre-commit and CI, so whatever lands is what the tool wants. I'd rather not hand-tune import order in review.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Agreed, formatting is the tool's job, not the reviewer's.
